If you’re one of the many people not getting enough of that good, sound sleep, Swanson Melatonin-Free Sleep Aid may be the answer you’re looking for. We feature a carefully crafted blend of magnesium, L-theanine and 5-HTP to calm your mind and body so you can get the restorative rest your body craves. Sleep is a result of complex biological activity and involves several important neurotransmitters— chemicals that send signals for a particular activity in the brain—such as GABA and serotonin. Supporting these neurotransmitters can lead to improved sleep quality (how well you sleep) and quantity (how much sleep you get).

paragraphs: As a dietary supplement, take two capsules per day 30 minutes before bedtime with water.

paragraphs: For adults only. Do not take this product if you are taking a prescription antidepressant or if you are pregnant or nursing. Consult your healthcare provider before use if you have a medical condition or if you are taking any prescription medications.
